name: worktrunk
description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
one_liner: A command-line tool that keeps multiple AI coding agents working on the same codebase at once without their changes tripping over each other.
buyer: An engineering lead running several AI coding agents in parallel (one per feature or client) who needs them isolated so their work doesn't collide.
business_use_cases: An AI-development agency running many parallel Claude Code sessions for different clients uses it to keep every client's branch cleanly isolated.
A dev-tools startup bundles it into a larger 'agent orchestration' product it sells to engineering teams scaling up AI-assisted development.
A consultancy teaches a paid workshop on 'running ten AI agents at once' using it as the core tool, selling the setup as a service.

money_ideas.idea: Paid support or setup consulting for teams adopting a multi-agent development workflow.
Bundle it as a feature inside a broader paid agent-orchestration SaaS.

steal_this: Build a lightweight status dashboard on top that shows which worktree each of a team's AI agents is on and what it's doing, and sell it to shops running several agents in parallel.
